verdict.rationale: This axis applies: a scraping platform could let developers drive its browsers with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy. The pack shows no such integration. Firecrawl offers its own scrape, crawl and interact APIs and SDKs, plus 'managed browser sessions', but nothing says developers can connect these libraries to them. A community remark that Firecrawl uses Puppeteer internally describes its implementation, not a developer-facing way to build scrapers with these libraries.
